title: Role of Copper-Albumin Complex in Treatment of Knee Osteoarthritis in Human
brief_summary: Osteoarthritis (OA) is one of the most common forms of degenerative joint disease and a major cause of pain and disability affecting the aging population. It is a significant burden in terms of cost as well as the health of society and individuals. Here in our study we will try to evaluate a novel therapeutic method by using topical copper-albumin complexes cream in treatment of osteoarthritis. Then all the biochemical changes will be measured beside the evaluation of topical copper-albumin complexes cream effectiveness in relieving symptoms of the OA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of both sexes and over 40 years of age diagnosed with unilateral or bilateral symptomatic OA of the knee who met the criteria of the American College of Rheumatology (ACR).
* Patients who were rated grade II or III on the Kellgren and Lawrence (K\&L) radiological scale \[19\].
* Patients with symptomatic OA with a global mean pain in the knee \>40 mm on a Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) for pain assessment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Women who were pregnant or breastfeeding
* Patients who were grade I or IV on K\&L radiological scale.
* Patients who have had a prosthesis replaced in the 12 months prior to inclusion.
* Obesity
